teaser: The Web Summit team's day of agents on schedules: 75 releases, four people connected, a procurement agent, and policies catching our own agents.
core_idea: On 2 November the Web Summit team's site made 75 releases. Four of nine people are connected, with 17 agents each under a behaviour policy. The conductor's briefs showed one of nine team agents on a schedule at 16:52 and nine of nine at 20:30; by the evening the agents worked unasked. A procurement agent collected print quotes, asking suppliers before publishing. The behaviour policies caught our own agents: writes outside a folder and a session signing under another agent's name. Five people have not started and some work is still a plan.

nodes.label: RiskMandate on ourselves
nodes.summary: Mandate against reach, inside a team.

quotes.text: The briefs are how I found out that most of them were not being woken.
It works under a rule I like: open by default, ask first.
Neither was an attack, and neither did harm.
quotes.why: The policies caught our own agents.
